test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: How many meaningful four - letter English words can be formed using the first, fourth, fifth and sixth letters of the word SAVOUR (when counted from left to right) using each letter only once in each word.
solution:
Given word: SAVOUR

 (left) **S **A V **O U R** (right)

The first, fourth, fifth and sixth letters of the word SAVOUR (when counted from left to right) are **S, O, U, **and** R**.

Thus, the meaningful four letter English words which can be formed are - **SOUR **and **OURS**.

Therefore, two meaningful four letter English words can be formed. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
